Smart Mart's flagship product is Instasalla, Kuwait's 1st Online Grocery Platform that provides delivery services from Hypermarkets and Grocery stores butchers, green groceries, and other Food and House Care suppliers.  It delivers within 90 minutes and that was reflected in the logo by using the green shades and the speed element indicating the swift delivery of the service and the freshness of its goods.
